title: How are you using AI in your game UI/UX workflow?
author: AeshKhan-
selftext:
Hey everyone! I am a UI/UX designer working mainly on game UI, using Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.

Currently, I only use ChatGPT to find references and ideas, then create the entire UI from scratch. This makes my workflow pretty slow, and I feel like I could be doing more work if I found ways to speed things up.

I would love to know how you guys are using AI in your UI/UX workflow, especially for game UI. Which tools do you use, and how do they actually help you save time without compromising the quality of your designs?

I would really appreciate hearing about your actual workflows and experiences. Thanks!
